title: Discovering Equations for the Thermodynamics of South Asian Monsoon Precipitation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14401v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: South Asian monsoon precipitation depends on the thermodynamic structure of the lower troposphere, but how its ingredients combine to shape precipitation remains unclear, partly because this dependence is nonlocal in the vertical. We use symbolic distillation, which combines neural networks and symbolic regression, to discover interpretable precipitation equations from 21 years of June-August reanalysis data. Neural networks first learn the vertical thermodynamic structure most relevant to precipitation, condensing each variable into a single interpretable feature not tied to a particular vertical grid. Then, symbolic regression derives closed-form equations from these features and the surface state. Our best equation explains 1.5 times as much precipitation variance as a widely used buoyancy-based diagnostic and recovers about 85% of neural network skill while using about a thousand times fewer parameters. Unlike the buoyancy diagnostic

translated_title: 发现南亚季风降水热力学的方程
translated_abstract: 南亚季风降水依赖于对流层低层的热力结构，但其各个要素如何组合塑造降水仍不清楚，部分原因在于这种依赖关系在垂直方向上是非局地的。我们使用符号蒸馏方法，该方法结合了神经网络与符号回归，从21年的6-8月再分析数据中发现可解释的降水方程。神经网络首先学习与降水最相关的垂直热力结构，将每个变量压缩为一个不依赖于特定垂直网格的单一可解释特征。随后，符号回归从这些特征及地表状态中推导出封闭形式的方程。我们得到的最佳方程所解释的降水方差是广泛使用的基于浮力的诊断方法的1.5倍，并在参数量减少约一千倍的情况下恢复了约85%的神经网络预测技能。与浮力诊断不同……
tldr: 该研究提出符号蒸馏方法，将神经网络与符号回归结合，从21年再分析数据中发现了可解释的南亚季风降水热力学方程，其解释能力超过传统浮力诊断方法1.5倍，同时参数量减少约一千倍。
en_tdlr: This study proposes symbolic distillation, combining neural networks and symbolic regression, to discover interpretable thermodynamic equations for South Asian monsoon precipitation from 21 years of reanalysis data, explaining 1.5 times more precipitation variance than traditional buoyancy-based diagnostics with about a thousand times fewer parameters.
